title: The serious encyclopaedia launched first.
description:
The serious encyclopaedia launched first. Nupedia was founded by Jimmy Wales, funded by Bomis, with Larry Sanger as editor in chief and a seven step review process.

Finished the whole review process by the end of Nupedia, with about 150 more in progress.

Proposed the wiki idea on the Nupedia mailing list and, on 11 January 2001, suggested the name Wikipedia.

The side project went live. It was meant to let articles be drafted together before entering Nupedia's peer review.

The side project outgrew the main one. English Wikipedia passed 200,000 articles in January 2004. Nupedia's server crashed on 26 September 2003, the date given as its end.

The careful project finished 24 articles. The side project did the rest.

Sources:
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia (read): established that Nupedia went online on 9 March 2000 with Jimmy Wales as founder, funding from Bomis and Larry Sanger as editor in chief; that it used a seven step editorial process; that 24 articles completed review with about 150 in progress; that Wikipedia began in January 2001 as a side project; and that Nupedia's server crashed on 26 September 2003, given as its end date.
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Wikipedia (read): established that Wikipedia began as a side project of Nupedia to allow collaboration before peer review, that the first edit was on 15 January 2001, that Sanger suggested the name Wikipedia on 11 January 2001, and that English Wikipedia reached 200,000 articles in January 2004.
